Page 005

005-2. ONLY THE FEW RINGS THAT CAME IN CONTACT WITH THE BLADE ARE SLIGHTLY DEFORMED.
005-3. EVEN IF MY SWORD IS SHARPENED,I HAVE TO SLASH AT THE SAME SPOT FIVE OR SIX TIMES IN A ROW BEFORE IT'S POSSIBLE TO INJLRE THE BODY.
005-4. TRY AGAIN, BUT ON MY BACK THIS TIME.
005-5. HOW DOES IT FEEL?

Page 006
006-1. PEOPLE WILL STILL BE A LITTLE SCARED WHEN GETTING SLASHED EVEN WHILE WEARING CHAINMAIL.ONLY THIS IDIOT ISN'T SCARED.
006-2. IT DOES AN OKAY JOB AT ABSORBING FORCE. IT FEELS LIKE GETTING HIT WITH A STICK, YOU CAN FEEL A'LITTLE PAIN.
006-3. IT'S UNCOM- FORTABLE IFYOU WEAR TOO THIN INSIDE, AND IF YOU WERE TO FIGHT SOMEONE, YOU'LL BE IN- VINCIBLE!
006-4. ALL THAT'S MISSING IS A HELMET,THE KIND THAT COVERS THE FACE.THIS THING IS REALLY BETTER THAN HAVING A BLADE!
006-5. IT'S ALMOST STAB-PROOF,THE TIP OF A BLADE CAN STILL GO PASS THE RINGS.
006-6. IT'S A PITY, IFI HAD THISIN THE PAST, WOULDN'T I HAVE BEEN ABLE TO WALK THROUGH THE BACKSTREETS?
006-7. ..ARE YOU GUYS PREPAR- ING TO GO WAR? TO

Page 007
007-1. NO,WE'RE JUST TRYING IT OUT, SINCE I'VE BEEN WORKING ON IT FORSEVERAL MONTHS.
007-2. I CAN'T BEAR TO TAKE IT OFF.
007-3. IT IS PRETTY USEFUL.
007-4. WITH THIS ARMOR, EVEN IF SOMEONE HITS YOU WITH A JIU HUAN DAO, YOULL BE INJURED A LITTLE AT MOST.
007-5. TS/N: The Jiu Huan Dao.
007-6. BUT...
007-7. ONLY IDIOTS WOULD AIM AT THE ARMOR,
007-8. THE NECK IS SO FREE.
007-9. WHYDO I HAVE THE CHILLS ALL OF A SUDDEN..

Page 008
008-1. The Culprit
008-2. WEIRD, IT'S GONE AGAN, WAS.IT-AN:ILLUSION?
008-3. TAKE THE CHAINMAIL OFF AND GIVE IT TO ME, I HAVE TO FIXTHE AREA WHERE IT WAS HIT.
008-4. IT'S TIRING AND PAINFLL TO WEAR THIS IN THE SUMMER WITH SHORT SLEEVES.
008-5. THE WORST PART ABOUT THIS THING IS THAT THE RINGS EASILY DEFORM AND NEEDS TO BE REPAIRED.AT BEST,IT CAN ONLY BE USED AS A DECORATION...
008-6. WHAT ELSE DO YOU WANT TO DO WITHITIFNOT TO DISPLAY IT?
008-7. I'M JUST SAYING, WHAT CANIEVEN DO? WIN AND YOUGOTOJALOE AND YOU GO.TO THE HOSPITAL.

Page 009
009-1. BY THE WAY, WHEN MY DAD FINISHES HIS, LET'S WRESTLE IN IT!
009-2. YOU GOT NOTHING BETTER TO DO? I'M NOT DOING THAT.
009-3. SPEAKING OF WHICH, WHAT KIND OF BULL'SHIT SWORD- SMANSHIP ARE YOU PRACTICING? WHERE DID YOU LEARN IT FROM?
009-4. IS THIS THE LONGQUAN SWORD? THE ONEON TAOBAO THAT COSTS A FEW DOZEN YUANAND COMES WITH FREE SHIPPING?
009-5. I SPENT AROUND 300 YUAN.
009-6. THINK .I IT'S WORTH LIKE 30YUAN MOST. AT

Page 010
010-1. IF YOU TAKE THIS OUT WITH YOU,IT'LLBE CONFISCATED.
010-2. I'MNOT GOING OUT TO KILL PEOPLE, SO WHY WOULD I TAKE IT OUT WITH ME?
010-3. THEN WHY ARE YOU PRACTICING YOUR SWORDS- MANSHIP?
010-4. IT'S JUST A HOBBY.
010-5. OKAY, IT'S FIXED!
010-6. IFTHERE'S NO ACCIDENTS, THIS WILL BECOME AFAMILY HEIRLOOM, PASSED DOWN FROMMY GENERATION.
010-7. AND...

Page 011
011-1. IF SHE REALLYGOES BACK, THE WARRIORESS CANTAKE IT WITH HER, AND SHE'LL BE EVEN STRONGER.
011-2. aozin
011-3. WHEN SHE'S FIGHTING SOMEONE, SHECANUSE HER ARMS TO TANK AND CATCH THE OTHER PER- SON BY SURPRISE WHILE THEY'RE SHOCKED.
011-4. BUT NOW THAT THE WARRIORESS HAS BECOME A HOMEBODY, SHE MIGHT NOT BE ABLE TO ADAPT TO THE LIFEOF BLADE AND BLOOD.
011-5. AFTER ALL, IT'S EASY TO GO FROM FRUGALITY TO EXTRAVAGANCE, BUT DIFFICULTTOGOFROM EXTRAVAGANCE TO FRUGALITY.
011-6. PERHAPS...
011-7. THE WARRIORESS STILL STAYS TRUE TO CERTAIN THINGS, AS THEY ARE DIFFICULT TO CHANGE.
